## About
Texas Elite Air Conditioning & Heating is a local, family-owned business run by Ozzie and Corina in Kyle. When your AC quits in the Texas heat, Ozzie shows up, figures out what's wrong, and explains it in plain terms.
Neighbors tell us they like that we don't upsell. Ozzie will tell you what he'd do if it were his own home and show you the small things you can do to keep your system running well.
We're rated 5 stars from 450 Google reviews, and we'd be glad to earn yours.

## Services
- Leak fix on the spot: Ozzie tracks down the source of the leak and often has what he needs to fix it right then.
- Replacing a coil: Ozzie and his crew replace worn-out coils, with a clear quote and good communication from start to finish.
- Preventative maintenance: Regular maintenance visits, plus no-judgment tips on the little things you can do between visits.

## FAQ
Q: Can you come out the same day?
A: When we can, yes. Reviewers mention Ozzie coming out the same day and squeezing them in on the hottest days. Give us a call to check availability.

Q: What brand of systems do you carry?
A: We carry Goodman systems, which are made here in Texas.
